nikkei_midweek.model_assumption: Independent Gaussian increments; mean zero remaining period; frozen statistical weekly sigma, three sessions left of five; no fitted intraday dynamics, jumps, autocorrelation or volatility clustering. Conditional risk is not a frozen forecast and is not empirically calibrated.
nikkei_midweek.note: A large midweek rebound does not settle the Friday market target. This arithmetic is a threshold diagnostic, not a trading recommendation.

model_limitations: Conditioning on a future Friday outcome after observing Tuesday requires an actual time-series model; here zero drift and iid sessions are assumed rather than learned.
Weekly sigma is scenario assumption, not a fitted empirical daily time-series volatility.
Household consumption is September reference period, reported November 10, and cannot establish causal response of Tuesday Nikkei.
October 2026 headline YoY 3.9% and core YoY 2.7% are analyst estimates only; not scoreable official data.
